topic: why a pendulum swings back and forth

text: This is a pendulum, a heavy bob hanging from a thin rod.
Gravity pulls the bob down, and it picks up speed on the way down.
At the top it is briefly still, then gravity pulls it back down again.
The rod keeps it on its arc, so it swings back and forth, over and over.
Its length sets how long each swing takes, about two seconds for one metre.
